page.layout: One page of text, single column. Running head at top with page number at top right. Annotations section headed by a centred title, then several short paragraphs in italic and roman. Signature and catchword at the foot. No margin notes.

main_text.p: ne consurgentes, ecce omnes erant mortui, & in cadauera redacti. Proficiscensque abijt, & reuersus est Sanherib rex Assur, & habitauit in Niniue. Et factum est, quum adoraret in tēplo Nisroch deum suum, Adrammaelech & Saraezer filij eius percusserunt eum gladio, euaseruntque in terra Armeniae, & regnauit Esarhaddon filius eius pro eo.
main_text.head: ANNOTATIONES.
main_text.p: Misitq; Eliakim.) Mittit rex Ezechias ad Iesaiā,non quòd ipse dubitaret de ope Dei,sed propter alias duas causas.Altera,ut caeteri responsis consilijsq; Iesaiae denuò in fide confirmaretur. Alteram, ut sanctimonia conspicuus propheta pro salute pusilli gregis apud Deum intercederet.
Dies tribulationis.) Propositio orationis Ezechiæ ad Iesaiam.

p.i: Amplificatio malorum per similitudinem de laborantibus in partu.

Ratio propositionis. Vide aut, quomodo magis angatur ob blasphemias nominis Dei,quàm propter alia quaecunq; pericula. Oportet de gloria Dei asserenda primo loco esse sollicitos, iuxta illud:Primùm quaerite regnũ Dei,&c. Vnde & Dauid Psal.79. Adiuua nos Deus seruator noster,propter gloriā nominis tui.& Messias ipse,coelestis Ezechias:San-ctificetur nomen tuum.

page.notes: Printed-looking long s rendered as plain s throughout. The initial M of "Misitq;" is a large woodcut-style initial joined to the word, read as M with [?] not needed. "tēplo" read with a macron for the omitted m. "Ezechiæ" broken across lines without a visible hyphen, written whole. "San-ctificetur" keeps the printed line-end hyphen. Roman/italic distinction in the annotation headings ("Dies tribulationis.)" roman, the rest italic) is judged from the scan and is not certain.
